# dsh-intellisense
English | 简体中文
dsh-intellisense helps you organize and discover tools in DeepSeek Harness. Group tools, give them c
lear names and descriptions, and save reusable profiles for different tasks. The agent can look up t
he tools it needs on demand.
## Usage
Read the usage guide for tool grouping, agent visibility and interface operations. You can also open
it from the plugin configuration page.
## Installation
**Official DSH Desktop:** Open **Settings → Plugins** in the app, search for `@aldveylor/dsh-intelli
sense`, and install it through the app's plugin manager. No command line is needed.
**Regular dsh web:** Run this command, then restart dsh web:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
**Custom profile:** Replace `web` in that command with your host's actual profile name:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Follow your host's restart instructions.
The bundle includes **Intellisense Preset** (`intellisense/preset`, entry `@aldveylor/dsh-intellisen
se/preset`), which registers the Intellisense and Intellisense PTC agent presets. The main component
provides namespace services and execution; preset registration is handled separately.
## Development
Read the development guide for agent preset `config.mode` / `config.profile` settings and builtin to
opment guide for agent preset `config.mode` / `config.profile` settings and builtin tool interfaces.
Requires Node.js >=24 and DeepSeek Harness >=0.2.1-rc.2.
### Install from npm
Start DeepSeek Harness once to initialize the profile you want to use, then stop it. In that profile
's directory (the directory containing its `package.json`), run:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
In the same `package.json`, append `"@aldveylor/dsh-intellisense"` to the existing `dsh.profile.bund
les` list, keeping the other entries. Restart DeepSeek Harness with that profile.
Ctrlernatively, open **Plugins** in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar and install `@aldveylor/dsh-intelli
sense` from the npm registry, with the bundle enabled. This handles installation and activation for
the current profile.
### Run from source
From the project root, with pnpm installed, run:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
This starts a separate development profile for trying the plugin locally.
Select an exact DSH version to test against a different host:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
The first run installs that host under `build/dsh_versions/<version>`; later runs reuse it and refre
sh copies of the local plugins. Each version uses a separate development profile. The project depend
encies and lockfile stay unchanged. Both entry points accept `--plugin <directory>` and forward othe
r arguments to DSH; use `--` to end launcher options.
## Tool management
Read the usage guide, also available from the configuration page. Screenshots below use light mode.
### Namespace management
The namespace tree shows tool groups, call names, and descriptions. Hover a namespace for its name,
full path, and notes; hover a command for its summary, full documentation, and call totals. Its orig
inal command name opens a second tooltip with tool details. Expand groups, double-click names or com
ments to edit them, drag sibling entries to reorder them, and set pinned hint levels. Use the contro
ls above the tree to switch, save, or save a copy of a profile for reuse across different tool confi
he tree to switch, save, or save a copy of a profile for reuse across different tool configurations.
### Adding tools
Click the tool icon beside “Namespace tree” to open the tool picker. The unmounted count opens a fil
tered list. Search by name, path, or description, then click an ordinary tool card to add it to the
current node. Built-in plugin commands appear as disabled gray cards.
### Tool details
Hover a card for its original name, description, parameters, return type, and call totals. Parameter
types have nested tooltips showing the type expression directly. Table titles sit outside their tab
les, and columns size to content. Hold Ctrl to keep a tooltip in place, then move into it to scroll
columns size to content. Hold Ctrl to keep a tooltip in place, then move into it to scroll manually.
